id: 11_Replace the Display Screen for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊机：更换显示屏
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/11_Replace the Display Screen for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/11_Replace the Display Screen for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K8: 撬起四角，揭下保护面板
points.K10: 抬屏拔排线，有胶先去胶
points.K11: 拆背面螺钉，屏和支架分开

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光焊接机旁，指着机器顶部的显示屏，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a gray wheeled laser welding machine, points at the blank display screen on its top, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看焊机的显示屏怎样更换。

shots.scene: 四个图标：警示卡、撬棒、显示屏、保护面板
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a warning card, a pry bar, a blank display screen and a clear screen protector. No people.
shots.narration: 揭面板、拆旧屏、装新屏、贴面板。

shots.scene: 阿杰在焊机前，显示屏一半花屏一半黑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at the laser welding machine; its display screen shows flickering stripes on one half and is black on the other half.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现焊机屏幕花了，一半看不见。

shots.scene: 老李提着工具箱和新屏幕走来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks in carrying a toolbox and a boxed new display screen.
shots.narration: 专业技术人员老李来换屏。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们看看怎么一步步换。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 换屏也属于拆机，只限专业人员。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机内高压和强激光，会触电、烧伤。

shots.scene: 拔掉插头的焊机，内部一个模块上闪电图标，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: An unplugged laser welding machine with a cutaway showing one module with a glowing lightning bolt icon, and an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 可能残留高压，至少等5分钟再碰。

shots.scene: 警示卡上一副绝缘手套图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning card with a yellow and black striped border showing an insulated glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 工作台上摆着两把细十字螺丝刀、撬棒、镊子、新显示屏和新保护面板
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench lie two thin cross-head screwdrivers of different sizes, a thin pry bar, tweezers, a new blank display screen and a new clear screen protector with a black frame. No people.
shots.narration: 备好3毫米、2毫米十字刀，撬棒和镊子。

shots.scene: 老李拿起新显示屏和新保护面板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up the new display screen and the new screen protector.
shots.narration: 还有新显示屏和新保护面板。

shots.scene: 老李关掉电源开关，拔下背面所有线缆
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the machine and unplugs all cables from the back panel.
shots.narration: 关机，拔掉所有线缆。

shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.section_title: 撬起四角，揭下保护面板
shots.scene: 机器顶部俯视，老李用撬棒插进保护面板一角
shots.prompt_en: Top view of the machine: the facility engineer inserts a thin pry bar under one corner of the black-framed screen protector.
shots.narration: 用撬棒撬起保护面板的四个角。
overlay: 撬起四角，揭下保护面板

shots.section_title: 撬起四角，揭下保护面板
shots.scene: 保护面板被整片揭下
shots.prompt_en: The screen protector is lifted off in one piece, revealing the display beneath.
shots.narration: 再把整片保护面板揭下来。

shots.scene: 老李用细十字刀拧下屏幕四周的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses a thin cross-head screwdriver to remove the screws around the display edge.
shots.narration: 用2毫米十字刀，拆下四周8颗螺钉。

shots.section_title: 抬屏拔排线，有胶先去胶
shots.scene: 老李把屏幕轻轻抬起，露出背面的排线插头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gently lifts the display, revealing a small ribbon cable connector on its back.
shots.narration: 轻轻抬起屏幕，背面连着排线。
overlay: 抬屏拔排线，有胶先去胶

shots.section_title: 抬屏拔排线，有胶先去胶
shots.scene: 镊子剥掉插头上的一点胶
shots.prompt_en: Close view of tweezers peeling a small blob of adhesive off the connector.
shots.narration: 插头上有胶，先用镊子剥掉。

shots.section_title: 抬屏拔排线，有胶先去胶
shots.scene: 手指捏住插头拔下
shots.prompt_en: Close view of fingers holding the connector body and pulling it out.
shots.narration: 再小心拔下排线。

shots.section_title: 拆背面螺钉，屏和支架分开
shots.scene: 屏幕翻过来，背面绿色电路板，老李拧下螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The display is turned over showing a green circuit board on its back, and the facility engineer removes the screws.
shots.narration: 用3毫米十字刀拆背面8颗螺钉。
overlay: 拆背面螺钉，屏和支架分开

shots.section_title: 拆背面螺钉，屏和支架分开
shots.scene: 显示屏和金属支架分开
shots.prompt_en: The display panel is separated from its metal bracket.
shots.narration: 把显示屏和支架分开。

shots.scene: 新屏和支架并排，红圈标出两个孔和黄色区域
shots.prompt_en: The new display and the bracket side by side, with red circles marking two bracket holes and a yellow area on the display. No people.
shots.narration: 新屏装支架，黄色区域和孔位要对图。

shots.scene: 老李拧紧背面八颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens the eight screws on the back of the display.
shots.narration: 拧紧背面八颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 显示组件放回主机，黄色一侧朝右
shots.prompt_en: The display assembly is placed back into the top of the machine with its yellow-marked side on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 放回主机，黄色那一侧朝右。

shots.scene: 排线插头插好，卡扣扣上
shots.prompt_en: The ribbon cable connector is pushed in and its latch clicks shut.
shots.narration: 接上排线，插到位。

shots.scene: 老李拧紧屏幕四周的八颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens the eight screws around the display edge.
shots.narration: 拧紧屏幕四周八颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 新保护面板对齐四角贴上，手掌抹平
shots.prompt_en: The new screen protector is aligned at all four corners, placed on, and smoothed down with a palm.
shots.narration: 对齐四角贴上新保护面板，抹平。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the laser welding machine with four icons behind: a warning card, a pry bar, tweezers and a screwdriver.
shots.narration: 专业人员操作，断电拔线，锁脚轮。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 孔位对图，黄色朝右，贴好新面板。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在亮着的新屏幕前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the machine with its new glowing screen.
shots.narration: 新屏幕装好了，下次见！
